sites.rationale: The ledger line from PMC12959882 explicitly states 'HA epitope in position 557 (on eAE1)' in a full-length, membrane-anchored kAE1 construct. Position 557 falls within EL3 (topology: 542-569), 16 residues from the TM7 C-terminus (541) and 13 residues from the TM8 N-terminus (570), well clear of both TM boundaries (>=3 required). Python confirms seq[556]='V' and seq[557]='L', so insert_after_residue=557 places the tag between Val557 and Leu558. No Cys residues and no NxS/T glycosylation sequons are present in EL3. The tag is described as 'external', confirming extracellular orientation. PMC9623938 independently describes a Myc tag at position 557 in the third extracellular loop of kAE1 (same eAE1 numbering), corroborating this junction. Full-length kAE1 construct (membrane-anchored, expressed in lentiviral system pLVX-TRE3G) carries an HA epitope tag explicitly stated to be at eAE1 position 557, within extracellular loop 3 (EL3). The tag is described as 'external' (extracellular-facing). Surface detection of the tagged transporter was performed. The same junction (position 557, EL3) is independently supported by PMC9623938, which describes a Myc tag at position 557 in the third extracellular loop of kAE1 (using eAE1 numbering, as confirmed by PMC12959882). [validation: surface_only; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sites.rationale: PMC11769940 reports V5 tag insertion into EL3 of full-length eAE1 (membrane-anchored, HEK293 expression), with surface biotinylation confirming plasma membrane display. The paper states EL3 as residues 555-576 for eAE1; the authoritative topology landmarks give EL3 as 542-569. No specific junction residue is named for eAE1 (the sequence shown, YNVLGKPIPNPLLGLDSTMVPK, matches kAE1 EL3 490-511 but is not found in the eAE1 canonical sequence at 555-576, suggesting the paper displays the kAE1 sequence for both isoforms). Because no junction is pinned for eAE1, this is reported as a region-level site with insert_after_residue=null. The site is distinct from Site 1 (HA at 557) because it is a different paper, different tag, and the junction is unspecified. cited_tag_residue is null because no residue is named. Full-length human eAE1 construct with a V5 tag inserted into extracellular loop 3 (EL3; stated as residues 555-576 for eAE1 in the paper, topology landmarks give EL3 as 542-569) was expressed in HEK293 cells. Surface biotinylation and immunoblot confirmed the V5-tagged eAE1 at the plasma membrane. No specific junction residue is named for the eAE1 construct; the paper provides only the loop boundaries. [validation: surface_only; position: inferred; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

literature_notes: Four ledger lines were examined. Lines 1 (PMC12959882) and 2 (PMC9623938) both support an HA/Myc tag at eAE1 position 557 in EL3 (topology 542-569); Line 1 is the primary citation because its verbatim quote explicitly names 'position 557 (on eAE1)'. Line 2's quote names only the construct labels without stating the position, so it is used as corroboration. Lines 3 and 4 (both PMC11769940) support a V5 tag in eAE1 EL3 with surface biotinylation confirmation, but no specific junction is given for eAE1; this is reported as a region-level site. No ledger evidence supports tags in EL1 (426-439), EL2 (472-486), EL4 (625-660), EL5 (713), EL6 (782), or EL7 (851-857); those loops are not proposed. The large N-terminal cytoplasmic domain (1-404) and C-terminal intracellular tail (870-911) are intracellular and excluded. The Myc paper (PMC9623938) also mentions a C-terminal HA tag (kAE1-HA), but the C-terminus of eAE1 (residues 870-911) is intracellular per topology, so that tag is not extracellular and is excluded. Position 557 has no Cys residues and no NxS/T glycosylation sequons in EL3, and is 16 residues from TM7 and 13 residues from TM8, satisfying all geometric constraints.
